propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads produced/consumed at port boundaries (OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote, InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local).

All remaining Jira modules (outbound_fields, adf, comment_limits, acli_subprocess, probe mechanics) must be physically relocated under adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims and all imports repointed.

Every package-root src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py module must have zero vendor reach-through: no adapters.jira imports, no lazy-key literals like 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira', and no by-path loads of vendor siblings (exception: inbound_fields.py).

Outbound differ, link differ, absence probe, and rich-text/comment-limit paths must be refactored to route through Backend port interface with vendor-shaped comparison helpers moved into adapters/jira/.
Backend selection via config.reconciler.backend through the registry with default 'jira' must reproduce prior end-to-end behavior.
All transport construction sites and provider literals must route through select_backend().transport or backend.vendor rather than using direct vendor imports.
